_comment: LOCAL-STACK PLAYTEST ACCOUNTS ONLY (scripts/playtest.mjs seeds them; src/dev/PlaytestBar.tsx signs in as them). The .example domain (RFC 2606) can never be a real account, and the seed refuses any Supabase URL that is not 127.0.0.1/localhost. One file for both sides, so the seed and the sign-in buttons cannot drift (P2).
